calibration_notes.x: Median width measurement across all rows
calibration_notes.y: Constant line spacing of the measurement configuration (3200 x 2000 grid, one scanner, one setting). Determined directly at this configuration from the measurement scans: mean of the per-scan estimates, corrected by an independent simulation scale fit (concave 0.15818, convex 0.15796; adopted 0.1581). Up to package version 1.1.0 the y scale was derived per scan from a square-part assumption, which let the anisotropic draw-in leak into the calibration (spread 0.1556-0.1614).
calibration_notes.z: Mean of 4 corner height differences (RANSAC surfaces)
